 ColorOS 17 November Rollout Schedule Revealed: Eligible OPPO, OnePlus and realme Phones
 By Team My Mobile 
 November 6, 2026 
 0 
 10 
 Highlights 
 OnePlus 12, OnePlus Open, and OPPO Find N3 get the ColorOS 17 update this month. 
 ColorOS 17 has improved animations, brilliant glass UI elements, and better system transitions. 
 ColorOS 17 is built on Android 17 with upgraded software. 
 OPPO has announced the November release schedule for the ColorOS 17 update for compatible OPPO, OnePlus, and realme handsets . The update will be released in phases throughout the month, with early flagships starting on November 5 and more series receiving the update on November 17, 18, 19, 23, 24, 25, and 26 . Users can anticipate this phased release over the air throughout the month to improve system responsiveness, refine visual aspects and provide seamless animations across supported hardware.
 The ColorOS 17 update enhances overall system efficiency, refreshes the visual interface with the new Laminar Flow Engine and offers customisation choices for users across all three brands. Users can check their system settings to see whether the update is available for their region and model.

 OnePlus Phones Eligible for ColorOS 17 Update in November 
 OnePlus phones are started getting ColorOS 17 update 
 ColorOS 17 is rolling out to OnePlus smartphones this month, with premium devices getting early access starting November 5, while upgrades for flagship phones and tablets will arrive mid-month.
 November 5 : OnePlus 13R 
 November 17 : OnePlus 12
 November 18 : OnePlus Pad 3
 November 24 : OnePlus Open
 November 26 : OnePlus Nord 6, OnePlus Nord CE 6
 Realme Phones Eligible for ColorOS 17 Update in November 
 This month’s ColorOS 17 update for Realme smartphones includes premium performance phones, as well as more affordable Number, P-series and Narzo handsets .
 November 5: realme GT 7, realme GT 7 Dream Edition
 November 18: realme GT 7T 
 November 19: realme 16 5G, realme 15 Pro, realme 15 5G, realme 15x 5G, realme 15T 5G, realme P4 Pro 5G, realme P4 5G, realme NARZO 90 5G, realme NARZO 90x 5G
 How to Check for ColorOS 17 Update 
 Go to the Settings app on your OPPO, OnePlus or realme smartphone
 Scroll down and tap System & update
 Select Software update to check for update availability
 If there is a new firmware available, tap Download & install 
 Restart the phone and finish the installation
 ColorOS 17 Features and Improvements 
 ColorOS 17 builds on system stability and design aesthetics to provide a more polished software experience. Key features of ColorOS 17 include:
 Luminous Glass UI : Soft translucent design with dynamic lighting and increased panel effects in quick settings and primary programs.
 Fluid Parallel Animations : Enhanced render engine for responsive touch and seamless app launch and switch transitions.
 Enhanced System Efficiency : Optimised background resource use to help extend battery life and improve app performance.
